clue.text: Animal with a head for heights

definitions.text: Animal with a head for heights

parts.words: Animal with a head for heights
parts.note: a creature whose head sits higher than any other land animal's, punning on having no fear of heights

explanation.definitionFit: The tallest living land creature carries its head metres off the ground on a very long neck.

clue.text: Leave for a holiday and get lost

definitions.meaning: to depart on a trip somewhere, as in going off on vacation
a rude command telling someone to clear off

explanation.surface: Someone told to take a break and disappear.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both travel off on a trip and, as an order, be off with you.

clue.text: Take Latin

parts.note: the Latin imperative meaning take, written at the head of old prescriptions

explanation.definitionFit: Old prescriptions began with the Latin word for take, which later named any cooking formula.

clue.text: Brothers terrify ant in play

indicators.note: letters in play are moving freely, so those of terrify ant are rearranged

explanation.surface: Monks frightening an insect during a game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in play' turns TERRIFYANT into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A brotherhood or college society of men is a group of brothers.

clue.text: Key-hole operation?

parts.note: E is a musical key
a vent is an opening or hole

explanation.surface: Keyhole surgery, the minimally invasive kind.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests keyhole surgery; the hyphen splits it into a key and a hole.
explanation.definitionFit: An operation in the sense of an occurrence or happening, as in a planned affair.

clue.text: With air-conditioning being installed, wise to find peace and quiet?

indicators.note: the air-conditioning is fitted inside the other word, as a unit put into a building

parts.note: privy, as in privy to, means in the know or wise

explanation.surface: A cool, quiet room after fitting an air-conditioner.
explanation.definitionFit: Seclusion from others brings freedom from disturbance and intrusion.

clue.text: A head for capital investment?

definitions.meaning: the head teacher or chief person of a school or college
the original sum lent or invested, as opposed to interest

explanation.surface: A chief executive looking for funds.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both chief person in charge and the capital sum earning interest.

clue.text: Move slowly in church

parts.note: CH is the standard abbreviation for church; that the letters also run unbroken across in church is a coincidence of this charade

explanation.surface: Creeping slowly along a church aisle.
explanation.definitionFit: To creep forward bit by bit, a small measure at a time.

clue.text: Perfect order for dessert

definitions.meaning: an idiom for everything neat and tidy
a baked fruit pudding in a pastry case

explanation.surface: Ordering the perfect pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for perfect tidiness and a fruit tart share the same name.

clue.text: Noel's pieces of firewood?

parts.note: Noel is Christmas, so its pieces of firewood are the large logs burnt at that festival

explanation.definitionFit: Big logs traditionally burnt at the Christmas season, as well as the chocolate cake shaped like one.

clue.text: New car is on account, but capital is required

indicators.note: in a down or across charade, one piece being on another means it follows it

parts.note: AC (or a/c) is the abbreviation for account

indicators.note: a new arrangement of the letters of car

explanation.surface: Buying a new car on credit in the big city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Ghana in West Africa.

clue.text: Alice pops out of the church

indicators.note: pops out suggests leaving, but out signals the letters of Alice pops thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A girl leaving church quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to bishops and church government, as in an Anglican church run by bishops.

clue.text: One bound to learn his craft

definitions.text: One bound to learn his craft

parts.words: One bound to learn his craft
parts.note: a learner tied by indenture to a master while learning a trade

explanation.definitionFit: A trainee bound by indentures to a master craftsman while learning a trade.

clue.text: Quietly fish in Isle of Man port

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction to play quietly
an eel is a long snakelike fish

explanation.surface: Fishing quietly in a harbour on the Isle of Man.
explanation.walkthrough: The Isle of Man is a self-governing island in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbour town on the west coast of the Isle of Man.

clue.text: Those in primary education, say, showing excellent form

definitions.meaning: the pupils of the lowest form in a school, an example hence say
of the highest quality or standard

explanation.surface: Young pupils performing very well.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the opening year group in a school and also means of top quality.

clue.text: Go-ahead to join low-key revolution

parts.note: to enter a club or contest is to join it
P is piano, the musical marking for soft playing
a rising is a revolt or revolution

explanation.surface: Permission to take part in a quiet uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: Go-ahead as an adjective describes someone full of initiative and drive.

clue.text: To slip up 1-0 against us is wrong

indicators.note: against means next to, so the next piece is placed beside

parts.note: to err is to make a mistake
the figures are read as the words one and nought, the latter as the letter O

explanation.surface: A football team losing one-nil, which feels unjust.
explanation.definitionFit: Mistaken or incorrect, containing an error.

clue.text: Drinking vessel

parts.note: a large sherry or beer glass, and also a ship that might be on the drink

explanation.definitionFit: A tall beer or sherry glass; also a sailing ship, a vessel on the briny.

clue.text: His word is law at a court building

indicators.note: building the word up afresh from the letters of at a court

explanation.surface: A judge laying down the law in a courthouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruler with absolute power, whose every command must be obeyed.

clue.text: Token expletive in defiant response

parts.note: a counter is a token used in games
blast is a mild curse

explanation.surface: Swearing out of defiance.
explanation.definitionFit: A vigorous retort or riposte against an attack or criticism.

clue.text: Still rings up, nevertheless

parts.note: still and even both mean yet more, as in still better or even better

indicators.note: in a down clue the letters read upwards

parts.note: rings are O shapes, so their plural is OS

explanation.surface: Someone keeps calling despite everything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns OS to SO under EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Despite that, all the same, used to concede a point.

clue.text: Extremely ragged

parts.note: worn into loose threads at the edges, and also strained nerves

explanation.definitionFit: Worn at the edges and also nervously strained, like tempers.

clue.text: Orchestral piece initially written on back of envelope

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A musician jotting down a melody on scrap paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A double-reed woodwind instrument, one piece of an orchestra's array.

clue.text: Type of agent having insurance?

definitions.meaning: a secret agent working in disguise
fully protected by an insurance policy

explanation.surface: An insurance agent selling cover.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means operating in secret and, read literally, protected by a policy.

clue.text: One means of support for an artist

definitions.text: One means of support for an artist

parts.words: One means of support for an artist
parts.note: a wooden stand that holds a painter's canvas, rather than financial backing

explanation.definitionFit: A painter's wooden stand that holds the canvas upright while working.

clue.text: Fine stuff that you can sit on in summer

definitions.meaning: a fine linen or cotton fabric

definitions.text: that you can sit on in summer
definitions.meaning: an area of mown grass in a garden

explanation.surface: A soft spot for a summer picnic.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of a fine linen cloth and of a mown grass area in a garden.

clue.text: They have telling parts in play

definitions.text: They have telling parts in play

parts.words: They have telling parts in play
parts.note: actors whose role is to tell the story in a stage play

explanation.definitionFit: Storytellers in a drama who recount events to the audience.

clue.text: Trouble caused by a small number in New York

indicators.note: the small number sits inside the abbreviation for New York

parts.note: NO is the short form of number

explanation.surface: A small group causing problems in Manhattan.
explanation.definitionFit: To trouble someone is to bother or irritate them.

clue.text: Seamen can put forth in tattered clothing

indicators.note: the can is put into the middle of the clothing

parts.note: rags are torn old clothes
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Sailors in torn clothes able to set out.
explanation.walkthrough: Seamen here are naval ratings, not officers; the can goes into the clothing's middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratings are non-commissioned sailors in the navy.

clue.text: Caught girl taking dictionary

parts.note: a lass is a girl
OED is the Oxford English Dictionary

explanation.surface: A girl caught with a dictionary.
explanation.definitionFit: Captured with a looped rope, as a cowboy catches cattle.
